phase: Phase R1 Task 1 — source-scoped concurrency independent rereview v2
summary: The audited direct descendant closes R1-SCOPED-H1 and R1-SCOPED-M1, and its direct physical-target handling closes the reported one-hop H2 examples while both focused unittest modules pass 64 tests. Acceptance remains blocked because H2 is not complete for a scanner symlink whose target traverses another in-repository symlink: the producer collapses the chain to the final regular target, omits the intermediate symlink from the artifact-bound dependency scope, and accepts changed-and-restored commits that can make the scan consume different bytes from the frozen snapshot.
blocking_findings: [high][R1-SCOPED-H2-REREVIEW] Symlink-chain metadata remains outside the scanner dependency and intervening-commit scope. _descriptor_for_existing_path resolves a scanner symlink directly to its final regular target at measure/business_operations_graph_baseline_snapshot.py:487-506, and _dependency_scope records only the scanner path and that final resolvedTargetPath at lines 894-909. _committed_scanner_drift therefore knows neither an intermediate symlink path nor its target metadata (lines 707-735). An independent temporary-repository probe used src/alias.ts -> ../shared/hop.txt -> source-a.txt, committed hop.txt -> source-b.txt during the scan, then committed its restoration. produce_scan_bracketed_snapshot accepted the bundle and reported dependencyPaths containing src/alias.ts and shared/source-a.txt but not shared/hop.txt. A real scanner can consume source-b bytes while the accepted archive replays source-a bytes, so the changed-and-restored source-binding bypass from H2 remains. Exact remediation: either fail closed when a scanner symlink target traverses another symlink, or discover and artifact-bind every in-repository symlink hop (path, lstat mode, target, and final resolution), include every hop in pre/post denominator/state/staged-diff and intervening-commit scope, and add a changed-and-restored intermediate-symlink adversarial test that must abort. Rerun both unittest modules and obtain another independent rereview.
